_comment: Tier-2 for surface_interaction:0 and :1. Seven wall models on one deck. surface_interaction:0 — 'diffuse 0.5 300' aborts with 'ERROR: Illegal surf_collide diffuse command (../surf_collide_diffuse.cpp:50)' and so does 'diffuse 300 -0.1'; 'diffuse 0.0 1.0' gives 'ERROR: Surf_collide tsurf <= 0.0 (../surf_collide.cpp:125)'; and the case the entry exists for, 'diffuse 0.9 0.3' — a swapped pair that happens to land in range, so a 0.9 KELVIN wall — runs with rc=0, no ERROR and no WARNING. surface_interaction:1 — 'specular' leaves the per-surf etot at round-off while surface collisions keep accumulating; the diffuse control on the identical deck is fifteen orders of magnitude higher, and 'specular 300' aborts with 'ERROR: Illegal surf_collide specular command (../surf_collide_specular.cpp:42)'. The specular assertion is a MAGNITUDE RATIO against the control run in the same script, never a stored value: a DSMC wall tally moves with the seed in value and in sign, so only the round-off-versus-physical separation is asserted. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 replaces the specular wall model with the diffuse one used by the control run, leaving geometry, seed, gas and tally untouched -- it removes the no-energy-transfer pathology. The diffuse/specular peak-etot ratio collapses from 4.292e+15 (the measured unmutated value; the denominator is round-off so the exact exponent moves with the seed) to 1. LIMIT OF THE CONTROL, recorded because it is real: the OTHER claim this fixture carries -- that an in-range argument swap (diffuse 0.9 0.3, a legal 0.9 KELVIN wall) is accepted in silence -- CANNOT be falsified by any mutation, because it asserts the ABSENCE of a diagnostic; no edit to the deck can make SPARTA complain about it. in_range_argument_swap_is_completely_silent therefore carries no mutation evidence and is unfalsifiable by construction. A related gap: the fixture shows the swapped deck is quiet but never shows it is WRONG -- it could compare the energy transferred at the 0.9 K wall against the 300 K control directly, and does not. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: specular_wall_energy_is_round_off_vs_diffuse=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/surf_collide_arg_order_and_specular_wall && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
